content.text:
Dragging a scrollbar's thumb works now, and the thumb is a plain rectangle that fills the whole width of the track, with no inset or rounded corners. Both changes are in `src/scroll_column.rs`, so they apply to every list with a scrollbar. I haven't tried it in the running app.

**Why dragging didn't work:** the drag state was recreated every time the scrollbar redrew. Each mouse move redraws it, so the drag was forgotten immediately. The state now lasts from one frame to the next.

**Test:** I added `dragging_the_thumb_scrolls_the_list`. It failed before the fix (the list didn't move) and passes now. The full suite has 121 passing, 1 skipped (it needs the real harness), and the same palette test failing as before. The build has no warnings.

**Spec:** the track section of `ScrollColumnScope` now describes the edge-to-edge square thumb and how dragging behaves. `piton check` and `piton build check` pass.
